page.title: Dikgokagano
page.intro: Golaganya diakhaonto tsa gago tsa papatso. Dikgwebo tse di tswang mo dipapatso tsa gago di goroga mo Dikgwebong tsa Me ka go itirisa, ka tiriso le ditshenyegelo ka moeteledipele mongwe le mongwe.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form e isa kwa Baeteledipeleng ba Me, tiriso ya letsatsi le letsatsi le ditshenyegelo ka moeteledipele, le boleng jwa moeteledipele jo bo romelelwang gape kwa LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).

connect.title: Golaganya LinkedIn
connect.intro: Saenela go tsena ka akhaonto ya LinkedIn e e laolang dipapatso tsa gago. Leadrat e bala fela diakhaonto tsa gago tsa papatso, Di-lead tsa Lead Gen Form le dipalopalo tsa papatso, mme e romela diphetogo tse o di tobelang.
connect.need1: Seabe mo akhaontong ya papatso LinkedIn (Mobogedi kgotsa kwa godimo).
connect.need2: Seabe mo tsebeng ya khamphani e e golagantsweng (Motsamaisi, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Motlhokomedi kgotsa Mosekaseki) - LinkedIn e tlhoka gore e abelane le baeteledipele.
connect.need3: Potso ya nomoro ya mogala mo Lead Gen Forms - di-lead tse di senang nomoro ya mogala ga di ka ke tsa tsenngwa.

connection.autoRenews: Phitlhelelo e ntšhafadiwa ka go itirisa go fitlha ka nako eo

connection.confirmDisconnect: Kgaola kgolagano LinkedIn ? Go tsamaisanya go a ema mme dithokene tsa phitlhelelo di a phimolwa. Dikgogedi, dipalopalo le pegelo ya tiro di a bolokwa.
connection.noPermission: O ka leba tsebe e. Go golaganya le go fetola dipeakanyo go tlhoka tetla ya "Laola Dipeakanyo".
connection.fetchHint: Di-lead tse dišwa di tlholwa metsotso mengwe le mengwe e le mmalwa mme malatsi a le 7 a bofelo a tlholwa gape letsatsi le letsatsi, ka jalo ga go sepe se se fosiwang. Dirisa seno go bona di-lead tsa pele ga o golagana, kgotsa go tlhola paka gape (go fitlha go malatsi a le 90 ka nako). Di-lead tse di setseng di le mo Leadrat di a tlolwa.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Bolelela LinkedIn gore ke efe ya baeteledipele ba yone e e neng ya nna ditsholofelo tsa mmatota. Fa moeteledipele LinkedIn a fitlha kwa seemong se o se tlhophang fa tlase, Leadrat e e begela LinkedIn , ka jalo dipegelo tsa gago tsa letsholo di bontsha boleng jwa moeteledipele mme LinkedIn e ka bona batho ba le bantsi ba ba ratang baeteledipele ba gago ba ba gaisang. Ke fela ID ya moeteledipele wa LinkedIn le hash ya tsela e le nngwe ya imeile e e romelwang.
capi.noRules: Ga go ise go nne le maemo a a mmapilweng.
capi.created: Phetolo e tlhamilwe mo LinkedIn le go mmapa.
